gloss: to write; to author; to pen

definitions.gloss: to write; to author; to pen
definitions.explanation: To write literary works, articles, or other texts as an author. Implies serious, professional, or scholarly writing rather than casual everyday writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小説|しょうせつ}→小説：01434_shousetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{執筆|しっぴつ}する。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{現在|げんざい}→現在：01556_genzai⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{執筆|しっぴつ}→執筆：04194_shippitsu⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧だ。
examples.english: She is currently writing a new academic paper.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教授|きょうじゅ}→教授：02589_kyouju⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{共同|きょうどう}→共同：02591_kyoudou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{執筆|しっぴつ}したものだ。
examples.english: This textbook was co-authored by university professors.

notes:
A formal word for writing that implies authorship of substantial works. Not used for casual writing like notes, text messages, or shopping lists.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{執筆|しっぴつ}→執筆：04194_shippitsu⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧: currently writing, in the process of writing
- ⟦{執筆|しっぴつ}→執筆：04194_shippitsu⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧: writing activities
- ⟦{執筆|しっぴつ}{者|しゃ}→執筆者：22346_shippitsusha⟧: writer, author
- ⟦{共同|きょうどう}→共同：02591_kyoudou⟧⟦{執筆|しっぴつ}→執筆：04194_shippitsu⟧: co-authoring
- ⟦{執筆|しっぴつ}→執筆：04194_shippitsu⟧⟦{依頼|いらい}→依頼：02594_irai⟧: writing commission/request

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write — the most general and everyday word for writing, applicable to anything from notes to novels
- ⟦{著|あらわ}す→著す：02279_arawasu⟧: to author, to publish — emphasizes the act of producing a published work, while ⟦{執筆|しっぴつ}→執筆：04194_shippitsu⟧ focuses on the process of writing itself
- ⟦{記|しる}す→記す：14238_shirusu⟧: to write down, to record — focuses on documenting or recording information, rather than creative or scholarly composition
